main_text.l: DE SECUNDO PRÆ-cepto, Non facies tibi sculptile, &c.
Idola etiam ethnicorum, veluti Jovis, & Mercurij, palàm coli posse docent Simoniani, Basili-diani, Manichæi.
Clàm & occultè id fieri debere contendunt Gnostici.
Idolothyta, & iis vesci, rem esse ἀδιάφορον[?] dicunt Nicolaitæ, Basilidiani, Valentiniani.
Imaginem Christi colunt Gnostici, Montani-sta, Helcesaitæ.
Heliotropium, & herbas quæ ad solem con-vertuntur, Heliotropitæ.
DE TERTIO PRÆCE-pto, Non sumes nomen Dei in vanum, &c.
Jurare docent, quasi rem indifferentem, & Manichæi.

page.notes: The Greek word ἀδιάφορον is read with some doubt because of print wear. The printed headings read "SECVNDO" and "fumes"; these are corrected to SECUNDO and sumes (vowel u, plain long s). The running head is "LEGIS." No page number is printed on this page.
